name: EliteCart
summary: Shopify cart drawer with one-click add-ons, a reward bar, in-cart upsells and translations, plus targeted upsell flows and checkout add-ons on higher plans.
best_for: Shopify stores that want a designed cart drawer with one-click add-ons, a reward bar and in-cart upsells, from a single-language store on Essentials to a multilingual store with targeted upsell flows on Professional
skip_if: you want to try a cart drawer without paying after the trial, since there is no free plan; or you need a price you can predict at high order volumes, because the volume ladder is not published
honest_knock: There is no free plan, and beyond the included 200 or 500 orders the price scales with volume on a ladder EliteCart does not publish, only two examples. The trial is 15 days on the listing and 14 on the pricing page. Checkout add-ons need Shopify Plus and the $79.99 plan, and we found no cancellation or refund policy.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Essentials · per month, billed every 30 days through Shopify in USD
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-15 on the Shopify App Store listing apps.shopify.com/elite-cart-upsell and elitecart.app/pricing, prices in USD) Two published plans and one on request, with no free plan. Essentials, called Essential on EliteCart's own pricing page, is $29.99 a month and includes 200 orders a month with one language and conversion analytics; above that the price scales with order volume, and the listing gives one example, an additional $10 for 500 orders. Professional is $79.99 a month, includes 500 orders a month and adds unlimited languages with AI translations, unlimited targeted upsell flows and custom HTML, CSS and AI sections; its example is an additional $20 for 750 orders. Enterprise is 'Contact us': everything in Professional plus an account manager, onboarding, no order limits, a custom SLA and annual plans. All charges are billed in USD, recurring and usage-based charges every 30 days through Shopify. The listing offers a 15-day free trial, while the pricing page says 14 days. The full volume ladder is not published, only the two examples.

schema_offer.description: Essentials, billed every 30 days through Shopify in USD; includes 200 orders a month, then scales with order volume (listing example: an additional $10 for 500 orders); Professional $79.99 a month includes 500 orders (example: an additional $20 for 750 orders); Enterprise on request with no order limits and annual plans; no free plan; 15-day trial on the listing, 14 days on elitecart.app/pricing. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-15.

compare_with.name: Assortion
compare_with.why: Assortion is in our dossiers too and also combines cart customization with upsells, cross-sells and add-ons, but it starts lower and publishes its whole ladder: $9.99 a month up to 50 orders, $19.99 up to 200 and $34.99 up to 500 when we read it on 15 October 2026. EliteCart starts at $29.99 a month for 200 orders, with a reward bar in the cart and AI translations and custom sections on Professional, but beyond the included orders only gives examples. For a small store on a budget, look at Assortion; for a multilingual store that wants more control over the cart drawer, EliteCart.
